source.name: FC Famalicão, 'Bwin é o novo main sponsor do FC Famalicão'
source.quote: a presença desta marca na parte frontal das camisolas da equipa principal

source.name: FC Famalicão: Camisola Principal 26/27
source.note: The club shop's product photo of the sleeve (https://www.fcfamalicao.pt/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/FCF-LOJAONLINE-26270334_Easy-Resize.com_.jpg) shows 'chanceplus' and 'INTERMEDIÁRIO DE CRÉDITO' on the navy sleeve; the front photo (https://www.fcfamalicao.pt/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/FCF-LOJAONLINE-26270329_Easy-Resize.com_.jpg) shows bwin across the front and the Puma logo.

source.name: Footy Headlines: FC Famalicão 26-27 Kits Revealed
source.quote: Made by Puma, the FC Famalicão 26-27 shirts will be worn in the upcoming Primeira Liga campaign.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention.

summary: bwin on the front: the club announced a three-season main-sponsor deal on 19 August 2026, with the brand on the front of the first-team shirts and the naming of the Estádio Municipal's east stand. Chanceplus on the sleeve in the club shop's photos of the Camisola Principal 26/27; Puma makes the kit. Not marked complete: no cited source shows the back of the shirt or the shorts, so their sponsors aren't recorded yet.
